title: SEO Setup
description: Configure Yoast SEO or Rank Math, connect Google tools, and set up essential on-page SEO foundations

steps.title: Install and configure SEO plugin
steps.instructions: Install Yoast SEO or Rank Math. Run the setup wizard. Set organization name, logo, and social profiles.

steps.title: Set home page meta title and description
steps.instructions: Edit the home page and set a unique, keyword-rich meta title (50–60 chars) and meta description (150–160 chars) in the SEO plugin panel.

steps.title: Configure title templates
steps.instructions: Set SEO plugin title templates for posts, pages, categories, and archives. Use %%title%% + %%sitename%% pattern.

steps.title: Generate and submit XML sitemap
steps.instructions: Enable the sitemap in the SEO plugin. Verify it exists at /sitemap_index.xml. Submit to Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.

steps.title: Connect Google Search Console
steps.instructions: Verify site ownership in GSC. Submit sitemap. Check for crawl errors after 24 hours.

steps.title: Install Google Analytics / GA4
steps.instructions: Install analytics via Site Kit, MonsterInsights, or manual gtag snippet. Verify data is flowing in GA4 Realtime report.

steps.title: Set up robots.txt
steps.instructions: Review and customise robots.txt. Disallow /wp-admin/, /wp-login.php. Allow /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php. Add Sitemap: directive.

steps.title: Configure social Open Graph meta
steps.instructions: Set default Open Graph image (1200×630px). Verify title and description appear correctly when shared on Facebook and X.
